name: EPIC 211345800
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 10.6 solar radii and 1.26 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,585 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.26 solar masses and 10.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,005 K at its surface.
